# Hibiscus 0.8.33

This update improves everyday editing, adds dictation choices, and brings
in-app purchase prices in line with the current launch offer.

- Founder now shows the $19 one-time launch price with its $39 regular price.
  Lifetime Updates is $99 one time. Existing purchases and licenses are unchanged.
- Command-N preserves early typing while the new note's editor is opening.
  The note-search keyboard shortcut also places typing in the search field.
- Apply italic, bold, underline, strikethrough, highlight, and text color across
  multiple selected lines. Heading and Body actions work across the selection;
  inline formatting preserves Unicode text and supports a single undo action.
- Choose Always show, Auto-hide, or Hidden for the bottom formatting bar in
  Settings > Appearance. Formatting keyboard shortcuts remain available.
- Dictation adds ElevenLabs Scribe v2, Soniox v5, and newer OpenAI transcription
  choices. Hosted models require their provider key and upload audio after Done.
  Whisper Large v3 Turbo is the recommended local download, including Turkish;
  your existing model selection is preserved.
- Dictation Settings saves only API-key fields you edit, leaving other saved
  provider keys untouched.
- Unsupported native window-tab commands are removed from the View menu.
- Setup's One Pro Features page uses the native sheet's rounded corners,
  removing the extra white edges around the dark page.

The intermittent resize crash and broader large-library slowdown remain under
investigation; this update does not claim to resolve them. Meta dictation is not
included. No note migration is required.
